description: Frases por técnica para los prompts de imágenes y negativos para ComfyUI.

negativeByMedium.line-art-halftone: 3d, photo, realistic, gradient, soft shading, color fill everywhere

mediumPhrase.pixel-art: high quality pixel art sprite, clean 1px dark outline, 3-tone shading, limited palette, crisp pixels, game asset
mediumPhrase.flat-vector: flat vector illustration, clean shapes, bold colors
mediumPhrase.hand-drawn: hand-drawn illustration with expressive ink lines
mediumPhrase.line-art-halftone: quirky cartoon line art with thick black outlines, white fill and halftone dot shading, retro comic sticker
